comment: Seccomp profile for gitlab container (dai/gitlab:v1.3, omnibus GitLab EE on Ubuntu 24.04). Allows all Docker-default syscalls and additionally blocks the mount-family syscalls (CVE-2026-27456, affecting bsdutils/libblkid1/libmount1/libsmartcols1/libuuid1/mount/util-linux) plus general kernel-tampering syscalls. Scope: only covers sast/report/gitlab_v0_vulner_report.md section 1 (Ubuntu 24.04 OS base packages). Verified by inspecting the actual image (docker run --entrypoint /bin/bash dai/gitlab:v1.3): the omnibus runtime (PID1 /assets/init-container -> runit) never calls mount(2)/umount(2) itself; the only mount-related feature is the 'mountpoint' check in cookbooks/gitlab/templates/default/mount_point_check.erb, which is only rendered when node['gitlab']['high_availability']['mountpoint'] is configured -- NOT set in docker-compose_vm3_secure.yml's GITLAB_OMNIBUS_CONFIG. ptrace/bpf/perf_event_open are intentionally NOT blocked here (unlike seccomp-bcp-pipeline.json/seccomp-dagster.json) because this is an interactive, ops-debugged production-adjacent service where admins may legitimately attach gdb/strace via `docker exec` for troubleshooting; blocking them is not driven by any CVE in this report section and the risk/benefit tradeoff is different from the single-purpose batch containers.

syscalls.comment: CVE-2026-27456 (util-linux/mount family TOCTOU / privilege escalation): block all mount-family syscalls. Verified omnibus GitLab never calls these itself in this deployment's configuration (no high_availability['mountpoint'] set).
General attack-surface reduction (not tied to a specific listed CVE in this report section): block kernel module loading. GitLab has no legitimate use for this inside the container.
General attack-surface reduction: block kernel exec replacement. Not needed by any GitLab component.

General attack-surface reduction: block swap control and hostname changes from inside the container. Container hostname is fixed at creation time via docker-compose `hostname:`, not changed by any GitLab process at runtime.
